subject: Your application for Data Engineer (Reference: local-fixture-1)
body:
Dear candidate,

Thank you for applying for the Data Engineer role at Local Fixture Employer
(reference local-fixture-1).

After careful consideration, we have decided not to progress your application
to the next stage on this occasion. The team was impressed by your background,
and we would encourage you to apply again for future openings.

We wish you the very best in your search.

Kind regards,
Local Fixture Employer Talent Team
